---
name: Feature request
about: 建议改进或新增功能（Suggest an improvement or a new capability）
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 要解决的问题 / Problem

这个功能能解决什么问题？
What problem would this feature solve?

## 建议方案 / Proposed solution

描述你的想法。如果会改动协议、接线或机械接口，请说明兼容性影响。
Describe the idea. If it changes the protocol, wiring, or mechanical interface,
explain the compatibility impact.

## 考虑过的替代方案 / Alternatives considered

你还尝试或考虑过哪些做法？
What else did you try or consider?

## 影响范围 / Scope

- [ ] 固件 / Firmware
- [ ] 机械与 CAD / Mechanical & CAD
- [ ] 手机 App / App
- [ ] 文档 / Documentation
- [ ] 测试与工具 / Test & tooling

## 安全影响 / Safety impact

是否会影响停车行为、叶片安全、电池安全或结构强度？请说明。
Could this feature affect stop behavior, blade safety, battery safety, or
structural strength? Describe.

## 补充信息 / Additional context

草图、链接或测量数据。不要包含厂家手册或个人信息。
Sketches, links, or measurements. Do not include vendor manuals or personal data.
